economic_hypothesis: During a causally known bull market, a broad correction can force liquidity-motivated selling without ending the trend. A previously strong stock in a healthy industry that loses materially less than the market, closes high in its range, and trades normal-or-higher turnover reveals relative demand. Entry after the completed correction seeks resumption as forced supply normalizes.
entry: first legal daily open after signal within three market sessions
failure_exit: after T+1, first completed close below signal-day low; next legal open

four_binding_conditions.BROAD_CORRECTION: signal-day eligible-universe median return <= -1.0% and positive-stock share <= 40%
four_binding_conditions.HEALTHY_RESILIENT_INDUSTRY: prior PIT industry median ret20 > 0, positive-ret20 share > 50%, n20 >= 5; signal-day industry median exceeds market median by >= 0.3 percentage point
four_binding_conditions.PRIOR_PIT_BULL: immediately prior completed market state is BULL
four_binding_conditions.RELATIVE_LEADER_DEMAND: pre-signal completed ret20 in [+5%,+50%]; signal return >= max(-1.0%, market median +2.0 percentage points) and <= +8%; close location >=60%; turnover >=80% of prior20 mean
